note:
R122 - which vocabulary Studio's field-view path can attach to each player style / nationality / birth-state field, per distinct source
(coordinator R119-R121 review: "inspect the real consumer path"). Static reading of the current source rules, not an executed resolver:
  * TOML bindings: every defs/enums/*.toml [[bindings]] (table_raw_id, field_raw_id) and its [scope] games (none = every title);
  * ids: gen7 (big-endian) metadata keys are byte-reversed relative to Studio's canonical ids (yvSd -> dSvy); canonicalised here;
  * gen6 override gate (attributes.rs is_gen6_style_schema): dSvy field mQoE with bit width 3 -> synthetic NHL 07 style vocabularies
    (dSvy.mQoE skater 1..7, mHuy.wJus goalie 0..2) and GEN6_COUNTRIES for ubPc.Lelh / ubPc.QvxI >= 66.
Per source: each table carrying a style field (playerstyle / p_style / g_style) with its studio id, bit width and value set, plus the
vocabulary route the rules give it (toml:<file> / gen6-synthetic / none -> raw number). Title id per source is the anchor directory name.
Usage: python r122_style_consumer_scope.py <repo> <out.json>
